title: Pre-demo onboarding hold: NDA + vendor questionnaire required
text:
Pre-demo onboarding hold: NDA + vendor questionnaire required

['From: Security Team <security@hillsidehealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@hillsidehealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake + questionnaire before demo

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for coordinating the demo for Hillside Health. Before we can proceed to a live demo on our end, our security and procurement teams require two items: a completed vendor security questionnaire and a signed mutual NDA. I’ve attached the latest questionnaire (Hillside_vendor_questionnaire_v2.pdf) — it’s a short form but we need answers in each section and an indication of hosting location (cloud regions) and encryption controls.

Separately, procurement requires a countersigned NDA. We can accept a PDF upload or a DocuSign envelope. If you can send the NDA back by EOD Friday our internal scheduling will clear the demo for next week.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will: 
- Complete the attached questionnaire and return it to this thread,
- Provide a signed NDA (we prefer DocuSign but PDF is fine), and
- Confirm whether protected health information (PHI) will ever be sent in demo data (yes/no)?

If the paperwork will take longer, please advise and we’ll push the demo until gating is complete.

Thanks,
Samira Patel
Security Program Manager
Hillside Health

Attachment: Hillside_vendor_questionnaire_v2.pdf (pdf)', 'From: rachel.kim@redwood.com
To: Security Team <security@hillsidehealth.com>, procurement@hillsidehealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor intake + questionnaire before demo

Hi Samira — thanks for the checklist and the questionnaire.

Quick update from our side:
- We’ll fill out the questionnaire and return it by EOD Thursday (11 Mar) — Marissa (CC’d) will lead the form.
- I’ve initiated a DocuSign for the NDA and expect a signed copy back to this thread by Friday.
- For the demo we will NOT send any PHI. We’ll use synthetic redacted examples and a staging dataset.

Given those timelines, can you tentatively hold our demo slot on Monday (15 Mar) at 10am PT? If procurement/security need more time we’ll be flexible to move to the following week.

I’ve attached the DocuSign link in case procurement prefers that route.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://docusign.com/envelope/example-id-xyz
', 'From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: Security Team <security@hillsidehealth.com>, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Completed questionnaire + signed NDA (attached)

Samira / Hillside team —

Attached: completed vendor questionnaire (answers filled inline) and our countersigned NDA (Redwood_NDA_signed.pdf). I answered the controls section with our current defaults and added notes on regional hosting (US West / US East availability) and KMS options.

Short answers to the PHI question: we do not process PHI for this demo; we recommend using the sample data in the questionnaire appendix.

If you see anything that needs clarification in our responses, please mark up the PDF or flag the question number and I’ll follow up immediately.

Thanks — looking forward to confirming the demo time once you’re clear.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Hillside_vendor_questionnaire_v2_filled.pdf (pdf), Redwood_NDA_signed.pdf (pdf)
', 'From: Security Team <security@hillsidehealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@hillsidehealth.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor intake + questionnaire before demo

Hi Rachel / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for signing the NDA. We reviewed the completed questionnaire; a couple of small clarifications needed on the encryption key rotation cadence and where logs are stored (we flagged Q12/Q17 inline). Could you either: (A) drop a short note in reply clarifying those two items, or (B) we can take a 15-minute call this week to go over them.

Regarding the demo slot: since you submitted the paperwork we can confirm the demo, but we need a final confirmation that the clarifications will be answered before the live session. Can you confirm availability for a quick 15-minute call on Wednesday (17 Mar) at 09:30 PT, otherwise we’ll move the demo to Thu (18 Mar) at 10:00 PT.

We’ll hold the slot tentatively until EOD Tuesday, then lock the calendar based on your reply.

Best,
Samira Patel
Security Program Manager
Hillside Health
